video.title: 在你想要放弃时，想想是什么，让你坚持走到这里 #824科比日 #科比
video.scriptRefined: Tonight is the understanding thatthose times when you get up early and you work hard,those times when you stay up late and you work hard,those times when you don't feel like working,you're too tired,you don't want to push yourself, but you do it anyway,that is actually the dream.
